reviews.review_description: Very happy with Qld Commercial Solar. Mark was informative, listened to me and was easy to deal with. Communication was very good. Installers were punctual,  professional and friendly.

Sales/quoting process was flawless, but would have been good to have a face-face at time if quoting.Happened on my request for more information later.Installation went flawlessly. Installers were very informative and helpful on completion.
The whole process was easy and efficient. The communication throughout was excellent. Everything was clearly explained. I was happy with the price.
Will refer on with confidence. Most pleased with the installation.

The quoting process and installation went without a hitch; these guys clearly know their business. We haven't had any post-installation follow-up, and there are some lingering questions, but they are minor. To be fair, the SE Qld cyclone came through just shortly after the installation, so it was not exactly business as usual.In summary, good price for quality equipment and installation. The sales and installation staff were both helpful and easy to get along with. Not yet a month has gone by but so far, so good.

The installation was excellent and the team was very knowledgeable and easy to talk with. We had some challenging aspects to the installation and it wasn’t a hassle for the team at all. The quoting and pre-install process was a little tricky to follow but the end result was a value for money system that seems to delivering the output we expected.
I requested several quotes and each time they were provided promptly. Communication on installation date was good. Installation went smoothly. Performance to date (1st month) seems good.

From our first meeting with Mark the salesman we found QCS a great company to deal with, on time and professional.  Mark explained how everything would work and showed us the App we could use.   All went very smoothly on the day of installation a week after accepting the quote. The electrician and roofer were very professional and listened to us about where we wanted to place our inverter and panels.    They were on time and finished when they said they would be, without any hitches.  Sam our electrician, helped us set up our App to check on supply and operation of the panels. Any follow up service is guaranteed. Cost of the panels was in the ballpark for this type of work with a reputable local company. We are very happy with the service and installation of our solar panels. We are now awaiting our first bill to see how much we have saved.  Happy to recommend QCS to our friends.

Great price, the quoting process my not be as refined as other companies, but the price was good and Mark was happy to answer any questions about the perspective system. Some uncertainty around the install date, but that was due to rain. Overall I'd recommend them for sure. Installer Jimmy was excellent.

Quoting process with this installer was a little chaotic. Quotes provided by email based on satellite photos. No one sent to review the site, but I had gone to a lot of trouble to make it an easy installation. No-one pointed out that a wifi service was needed to obtain the monitoring - the inverter is in a shed 40m from the wifi in the house so I've had to create a new data-only account for the shed/inverter. That was an extra $250 (modem) + $95 per year for the data plan that I wasn't expecting.Installation on the day was very quick and professional - system is neat and seems to be working as expected. Hard to know for sure since we haven't had a sunny day in the 2 weeks since the system has been installed. Although there does appear to be a high grid voltage problem in this area causing the inverter to log errors.

Quality service from start to finish. Thank you for putting me int touch with Mark Hunt and his team. However, I rang re inverter issues and a sparky attended the next day, awesome service. It should be a standard policy to follow up with the client after a week or 2 though.

Obtained quotes from multiple companies - analysed price, quality of components on offer, before deciding on Queensland Commercial Solar. After site visit confirmed to need for a scissor lift to get access to the roof of our three storey terrace house. Install of  24 panel system took about 6 hours, and the installers were extremely polite, very efficient and cleaned up after the job. Couldn’t recommend them highly enough. Cost of the scissor lift was $500, on top of the system quote of $8300. No up front deposit required - payment in full expected within 7 days of completion.

The sales and quoting process was very straight forward and relaxed. Mark provided a lot of useful information when he visited, and there was no pressure at all. The quote was very competitive.Installation went very smoothly, the crew arrived on time. They were courteous and relaxed, and did a great job. I received an introduction into how the system operates and how to use the app.Overall we're very happy with the system and the service we received, all the paperwork had been organised by Queensland Commercial Solar Gold Coast, and communication was good. Happy to recommend them.
The ability of the technicians to put in plain language the technicalities of each component was what impressed me about Qld Commercial.

Solar quotes provide you with info about systems and what to look for. I received 3 contacts within 2 hours of enquiring. All 3 were polite and easy to talk to. I had lots of questions and Mark at Queensland Commercial Solar was always happy to answer them and also very open. Of the 3 quotes this was the mid priced. I wanted to be able to view my solar energy on an app so that narrowed the quotes to 2. The products were similar quality and I went with Mark because of how responsive he was and how quickly they could come and fit the panels. The installation team were great; polite, tidy and explained everything I needed to know. They installed the lot in half a day! So easy!

The sales/quote process was really good - informative & didn't mind how many questions I asked. I had asked for specific panels for my quotes & QCS were the most competitive. They were always prompt with any of my email/text inquiries too. The quote was for 2 houses & I had asked for an onsite visit to one of them (an older house) & the boss obliged. They were ready to install both in about 7-10 days from quote acceptance.The installation was really well done - arrived on time, nice polite crew & they cleaned up the packaging rubbish & left the site tidy. They helped my husband get the App installed on his phone too.Customer service has been great - QCS lodged the applications for grid connections. One house already had solar, so it was connected straight away. The other house needed a meter change (by the energy retailer) & took a bit longer to get connected.Payment was made after the installment - no deposit required.

Quote was informative around the options for locating panels & delivered in a timely manner. Installation was smooth with end result being tidy & efficient. QCS arranged for meter upgrade. Installer got us hooked up to the monitoring app on our phones at the end of the install. We had confidence at every step that QCS knew their stuff. A good experience all round for a reasonable price.
Quote was easy. Installation crew great, happy to answer any questions

Quick response with quote. No advice from the company on placement or expected performance of the system.Subcontractor did a good job on the installation. Turned up on time and when advised.All connected efficiently. System appears to be running well with best day so far 40 kw.Every thing handled efficiently but feed back from the company seemed minimal.

As well as honest pricing it was probably the Salesman's personality and knowledge which made me comfortable to choose QC.  Their quote did lack some of the detail provided by others (charts and graphs of predicted output) which would establish a baseline from which to monitor actual performance.  The office team were good (quick) with the paperwork to the point that it and the invoice arrived before the job was finished and it listed panels that were substituted with others, with a cost benefit to us I am pleased to say. I have been promised this will be rectified.The installation team was fantastic, listening to suggestions about panel and inverter placement and very tidy with the cable routing. The system has yet to be commissioned, the guys simply ran out of time after a long days effort. We have agreed a return visit.
Good price and good quality installation, on time and professional. Connected to the grid very quickly. Would have liked some after sales / installation guides.

Our dealings with Qld Commercial Solar Brisbane was a positive one from start to finish.Callum quoting on the project was our first contact and being very uneducated on how or what was best for us, explained everything in layman’s terms so we understood exactly what we needed and priced it accordingly.We proceeded weeks later and the installation was prompt and efficient, taking only a matter of hours of it being installed and working. They took care of everything with our energy supplier with us not having to do much more than pay the final invoice.We highly recommend Qld Commercial Solar Brisbane.

As a single lady with very little experience/knowledge of solar systems, I found QCS (Callum) to be very helpful in determining what would work best for me.The installation team were great.  They were punctual, helpful and friendly, whilst working on one of the hottest days in February!Customer service post installation has been helpful.

Quoting was thorough and willing to adjust system components.Install team arrived early and were very professional.The grid connection was setup and a meter upgrade organised for me and I was shown how to set up a monitoring app on my phone.

Our decision to select/purchase happened with ease.  No fuss communications about the key points, a range of options to choose from, helpful responses to queries. Installation occurred ahead of schedule. Installers were friendly and professional and high quality.

Sales person was friendly, polite and knowledgeable. I didn't feel pressured in any way.The installation went well, both the panels and the inverter. Meters had to be relocated to comply, this was an extra but at a very competitive price.All connections etc were handled by QC SolarIssues with final system documentation took a few days to successfully resolve.

From my first meeting with QC solar I was extremely happy with the level of service and advice offered and provided. I was very open with QC Solar regarding getting multiple quotes which they were very supportive of. At no point did I get the 'hard sell' or pushy sales talk. When I had questions the company rep was very quick to answer me or provide further information for our own understanding.On install day the installers were early to arrive and ready to go by the scheduled install time. Post install the foreman walked me through the monitoring and system details and even helped me troubleshoot and solve when part of the process did not go as expected.Grid connection was arranged after install and is scheduled for changeover tomorrow (Jan 23).

Seamless, good communication from start to finish, install team great, just waiting for new smart meter to be installed and some sunny days . No problem recommending this company to anyone thinking of a solar system
Install done well on time on budget guys knew what they were doing.

Queensland Commercial Solar were very quick to respond to my request for a quote and provided a very solid proposal with quality products. From the sales person, management and installers - everybody provided a professional service and nothing was too hard. I highly recommend this company to anyone wishing to have solar installed.

We purchased our 10 kw system from Qld Commercial Solar. We received 4 quotes. Mark was very in depth in his presentation and professional. Panels were delivered and installed on time by a great crew. Would highly recommend this company
QCS provided a professional installation at an attractive price.  The equipment recommended matched other providers, but at a better price and installed professionally.

Engaged Queensland Commercial Solar on recommendation from 'Solarquotes'.  The sales person was very knowledgeable and easy to deal with, turnaround time from initial contact to fully installed system was only about 2 weeks.  Minor issues that occurred during and after installation were dealt with quickly and without any fuss.  System is working as expected, and am looking forward to (hopefully...) years of hassle-free operation.

Sales were very helpful in determining our needs and pricing accordingly. The installers were very consultative about panel placement and were efficient installing the equipment. The short training required was done in an easy to understand format.

- Easy process, great customer service.- Great value package- Salesman took the time to review my house, including going up on the roof to ensure the system would fit. Something that not other salespeople bothered to do.- Everything taken care of, including the grid connection.

As I was working away at the time the company responded to all my phone queries politely and promptly on the day of the installation they arrived on time were polite done their job cleaned up any rubbish and explained how the system worked in all a very good result

We called Queensland Commercial Solar for a quote on the recommendation of friends. From quote to connect the customer service was 5-star. The price came in under our budget as well as being cheaper than three others, for the panels and inverter of our choice. I really liked that the quote had no bells and whistles: it was just a straightforward price for a quick installation. (Some of the other quotes were hard to read and had a lot of flashy graphics showing assumed savings and CO2 reductions, as well as optional extras that made it hard to figure out the base price) The sales person Callum was helpful and personable, answered all of our questions and (big plus) didn't tell us we needed to chop down our big tree! With the help of SolarQuotes info I could make informed decisions about which panels and which inverter and QC would provide any brand we wanted. The QC Solar price was good so I took Finn's advice to put extra $ towards the top of the line inverter. We needed a new meter box and QC Solar bundled installation of that and a hot water timer into the price. QC Solar also took care of the grid connection with super quick efficiency. The 3-person installation team were qualified electricians and employed by QC, not contractors. They were punctual, friendly, efficient and left everything tidy. They were communicative on the day. Though I did ask lots of questions, which helps. But they gave straight-forward answers. When an issue arose, with old cable connecting the power to the house not being fit for purpose, they problem solved it, replaced the cabling, and kept us informed on the day to explain they'd need a bit more time for the install. No extra charge. Overall it was easy-peasy from quote to connection. Now we're cooking with solar.

Knowledgeable and great to chat to.Installation went without delay and promptly installed it. However I had to wait a week for Origin to come and replace my ‘digital’ meter, that was capable of using solar, with a smart meter. I was not prepared for this and quite disappointed I could use my solar immediately.Great service, they did organise the grid connection.

We chose Queensland Commercial Solar. The sales and installation process was all very professional from beginning to end. Our 8kW system has been up and running for a few weeks now. Queensland Commercial arranged our connection to the grid but that is not scheduled to happen with the energy provider until mid-to-late March. All three quotes provided were good, with some differences in approach and pricing. Queensland Commercial took the time to come out to the house, provided good insights to us, and answered our questions along the way. They were the only supplier out of the three that suggested moving the panels more to one end of the roof to minimise shading and make our system more productive. We thought this was an important differentiator. We are only a few weeks in but so far very happy with our decision. Our thanks as well to SolarQuotes - a great service and key to this positive outcome!

Finn Peacock Founder and CEO from Solar Quotes sent me 2 referrals for solar installations companies in my area . I contacted Mark Hunt, National Sales Manager for Queensland Commercial Solar Business Services and received a very prompt reply. He phoned and discussed with me the 2 different proposals which would best suit my solar requirements. The installation quote I accepted was very competitive. The installation was completed in a professional manner by their team of installers and I am very happy I chose Queensland Commercial Solar.Thank YouHeather H

All our dealings with Queensland Commercial Solar Pty Ltd were smooth from sales through to installation. We got a competitive price on quality system. Everything was made clear on the entire process and the installers were punctual,  efficient and tidy.

QCS offered the choice of a number of products that gave  the option of a range of prices to choose from. Their conscientious staff did the same job as I am sure they would have done for friends. The company’s years in the business are reassuring. I can offer no points on how to improve their service!

We recently had a large system installed at our home and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this company. From start to finish, everyone was professional yet friendly and answered all our questions. Callum spent a while with us talking us through the process, allaying any concerns and gave us a great deal. The installation team were prompt, efficient and helpful. Thank you Queensland Commercial Solar!

The quoting by QCS was genuine straightforward with no b——-——t talk, we were kept upto dated on the progress and Mark co-ordinated with other tradesmen that was working here, combined with very experienced installers who were very well presented and the workmanship unquestionable, they introduced themselves with us, their company vehicle was very tidy/clean, they worked as a team, a pleasure to watch their workmanship, at the completion of the installation they left our premises very clean & tidy and, explained the operations of the system in a language that a newcomer understood and they also organised for the grid connection to be carried out.We would strongly recommend QCS to any person considering having solar installed to their home.

They explained the whole process in ordinary ,simple  english  .The installation team arrived on time ,and carried out the job in a very professional manner.Very polite and tidy boys.Every thing was organised for me regarding connections. All that I had to do was pay in 7 days after the installation, which i was more than happy to do.                                    .

Cannot fault their performance all the way through the process from initial contact to commissioning of the system and post installation support.Professional team and high regard to customer service. Well done!

Mark went the extra mile by giving us a lot more information about solar in the future.I could not fault his quote or his knowledge. Mark was an absolutely well mannered salesman.He did not pressure us at all, just gave us true facts.We ended up with the best panels and inverter.  Glad we took his first advice.Queensland Commercial Solar is a good company and would refer anyone to them.
reviews.battery_brand: No battery installed at this time.  Will do later. (Other)

reviews.review_description: Mark, the salesperson at QCS was very thorough and spent a good amount of time working out the details of the system. Since I wanted Enphase micro-inverters and have a particular electrical setup at the property, it was great to work this out beforehand.The installers were very respectful and great to work with.Great job guys!

This whole process was so easy and  carefree!We initially had someone from QC solar knock on our door to get us booked in for an appointment which was quick and very accommodating. We met the lovely Callum, who sat down with us and explained everything in detail. Callum was professional, extremely knowledgeable and very patient with the million questions we had.The installation process was very efficient and we couldn’t be happier.Highly recommend, thanks so much QC Solar!
The quoting process was honest and detailed with open ended arrangements to do my own research allowed me not to feel pushed.

The Gentleman who sold the Air Conditioning was friendly, very approachable and not pushy at all which was what sold the deal to us.Installers very efficient, friendly and professional and did a fantastic job, completely tidying up after themselves- infact you would not have known any work was carried out.Highly recommend!

"Too confusing,too time consuming" are no longer an excuse for not installing solar when dealing with Qcs. Callum explained the whole process and options very well. Any questions,he was just a phone call away. He organized everything that needed to be done and the office kept me up to date with the progress. The installation also was a hassle free experience. Very happy from start to finish. Thank you.

The installation process was professional, and the installers briefed me before proceeding, to ensure that my requests were met. The products seem good quality from what I have read, and hopefully the product will deliver as suggested.The quoting process was very good, with no pressure to proceed.
Couldn’t fault the company. From the sales, To the quality of system & to the installation Team. Very happy
Quick response to request for quote. Excellent price. Pleasant sales person.Installation occurred on the stated date.Very satisfied

Great service from solar quotes after receiving the three quotes we decided on QueenslandCommercial Solar very professional and extremely helpful.Quality products and prompt installation of products.Would recommend using both companies.

I was impressed that they were the only company that came out and reviewed the premises. That is what mostly sold it for me and the company was easy to deal with and the installers knew what they were doing.Has been a great experience so far.

Sales and quoting process was quick and simple. He didn't over complicate everything.Installation was great. they were very polite and helpful.Everything ran smoothly and happened as and when they said it would.

I was referred to this company by a friend of a friend who in turn had originally got the quote via Solarquotes.com.auMy existing system was installed in 2009 (1.5kW) and wasn't helping my energy-saving goals much. It was time to upgrade.At the time of getting QCS in to quote, I already had several quotes and had spoken to numerous companies - each of which had provided me with varying degrees of confidence in their knowledge, expertise and professionalism. One firm who markets aggressively nationally were still phoning me the day before QCS' installation asking me to cancel the contract as they would beat their price! Needless to say, that firm's reviews on solarquotes are less than favourable.I hasten to add that the three firms who contacted me via Solarquotes were professional and pleasant to deal with, but in the end I chose QCS since I know somebody who had dealt with them recently.When Mark from QCS contacted me, I was impressed with his knowledge, impartial advice, and ease to deal with. His quotes were sent promptly and were easy to understand, and any subsequent questions I had were quickly and effectively answered. Their price was competitive, but I was most impressed with the company's reputation and the fact that they undertake commercial, as well as domestic work.The team of three installers (Jimmy, Jake and Jack) arrived on time, took time to discuss what they where going to do, asked for my preferences about inverter location, and even demonstrated aspects of the installation such as the racking. They were cheerful, polite and tidy as well as being super efficient, and even came back the next working day to check on a query I had.After a few days I am very happy with the system they recommended, and would recommend QCS highly to anybody in the Gold Coast/Brisbane/ NNSW region.

Matt knocked on my door and asked if I was interested in a quote. Face to face from the beginning was the best! Given I had been thinking about solar for a while, I said yes. Callum was excellent to deal with as a salesperson. Was great at explaining in laypersonâ€™s terms how the whole process worked and answered all my questions. I was worried about trying to keep my original pool solar matting while installing panels. Callum helped me problem solve this and in the end it was best to just remove and dispose of the solar matting. It has served me well for 20 years. Then the issue of trying to remove matting before install date. I couldnâ€™t find anyone to do this so rang Callum to delay instal. He offered the installers to remove for me, at no extra cost!! This is not something they normally do.Come instal day the guys were brilliant. Polite, knowledgeable, worked well as a team. Removed all solar matting which created a mess that they cleaned up beautifully. Once they finished two of the guys walked me through the system and bounced off each other beautifully.Only one problem TV reception didnâ€™t work that night. They had accidentally cut aerial. But no problem, Zack the electrician arrived and promptly fixed the issue. Great service from beginning to end. Well done!

Well worth the wait in installing our Solar Panels with Queensland Commercial Solar!From Sales Rep being very informative with the quote to installation which was prompt, on time & punctual!Staff were very polite, organised & on time.They organise the grid connections upgrade after the install, follow up from rep & electrician to install app!!All info sent from Queensland Commercial Solar office staff on both the Solar panels & Inverter, with a step by step process....We would definitely recommend this company!Reviews on SolarQuotes is unbiased & worth looking into before making a decision!

Great professional service all the way through. A pleasure to deal with, and made the transition to solar very easy. Sales process was relaxed and unpressured. Callum made everything very clear. Installers were slick and efficient. No broken tiles! :) Good communication and follow up. Happy to recommend.

I was happy with everything. We got a pretty good deal on high quality panels and inverter. The installers turned up on time and accomplished everything promptly. They cleaned up pretty well and explained the follow up with the Smart Meter. QCS were very patient with payment for the invoice as there were problems with the bank online site. I would recommend QCS.

The quote was punctal and the Salesperson approachable, giving open responses, devoid of detectable deception. I decided to do a roof restoration before solar panel installation and I only gave a few days notice prior to the booked solar install. The Salesmen agreed that it would be best to do prep work involving roof tile movement (brackets and conduits) and then come back once my roof restoration was complete, to put the solar panels on and finish their install.Only just had it installed so I can't add after install comments. Overall, happy with punctuality, friendliness and professionalism.

We had our solar installed about 6 months ago and are very happy with our decision to have QLD Commercial Solar install our system.As per the header, we found both the Sales and Installation team to be friendly, informative and helpful.I would definitely recommend QLD Commercial Solar.
Friendly team from start to finish - the sales person was knowledgeable and backed up the research I did online.Fast installation and super friendly service. Highly recommended

From initial enquiryQCS explained the system that best suited our needs and what our expectations could be if installed .We decided on the QCell panels with a 3phase Fronius inverterThe installers arrived and were the total professional, job done and commissioned  in under 4hrThe follow up was by email and explained the procedures to set up the account with our energy supplierMany thanks to the crew at Solarquotes for the relevant info to walk us through the Solar mine field

Quoting process was prompt with a range of offers.  Installation was prompt and on time, installers were very friendly and explained everything to us.  We also received a welcome pack with everything we needed to know.

Very easy to deal with, everything organised quickly once we made our choice, installation only took a few hours and connection to eofi monitorong set up immediately for us. Grrat price for the quality of the system

All the staff worked as one in getting my Solar System installed and up and running.Very tidy installation and no questions were unanswered. Also following up to make sure I had contacted supplier and made sure everything is set up for feed in power etc.

After all quotes and salesman I finally decided on an installer and hardware. Queensland commercial solar did a fantastic job with the install which was made difficult with double brick etc. The installers chose to spend longer installing the system properly ( all hidden wiring etc ) rather than the easy option. Thanks. The system is working really well.

Mark Hunt was the salesperson. He was fabulous.Installation was very professional. Punctual. Tidy. Polite. very efficient.Only thing was...I had to introduce myself.Yes they helped organise grid connection.

Quick and professional quoting for solar installation, without any pressure to make decision, great price for quality system, installation and processing of grid connection went very smoothly, no issues anytime, system working perfectly, thank you

The QCS crew were great.  It took them about 6 hours to install our 26 QCell panels and Fronius 3 phase inverter across 2 strings, after which they cleaned up and explained to us everything we needed to know.  No issues at all, so we would really recommend them.
The installation was amazingly efficient (3 guys, 4 hours) . Only hard bit is the wi-fi to my computer. Working fine

Very happy with the service, which was completed today, I might have had payed a little more, but the service I received was more than happy with the result, what you pay for is what you get, the installation was clean and tidy no hiccups or problems, wouldn't hesitate in referring qld/commercial solar to anyone.

The Sales person was great , the installation went perfectly, they were very professional, fast, tidy and punctual. Everything is connected , now just waiting for our electricity supplier to complete the process.

I got quotes from five vendors, all offering more or less the same hardware, but the primary point of difference was Mark (the sales guy I dealt with) was delightful to work with. He explained the costs of various systems, and most importantly, did not harass me for the sale once a week until I finally signed, like every other vendor. I am not kidding, the other vendors bordered on harassment.Also, I'm a stickler for professionalism, he did not insult or disparage any of the other vendors, he is the *only* sales person I had through here that did not back-stab other suppliers. His sales pitch is based purely on the quality of the work, and the product.QCSolar was not the cheapest vendor (nor the most expensive), but their install team were well presented, well spoken, and not a rag-tag team of random contractors who were just able to show up on the day. Having just endured the building of a granny flat, I've witnessed the absolute worst of construction teams and the QCSolar guys were great to deal with, answered all of my tedious questions with patience.Post-sales support has been great, and the system has been over-performing based on kwh estimates, so I'm extremely happy overall.

I highly recommend Queensland Commercial Solar who made the process an easy one. There was no sales pressure and they were very competitive. Installation day went without a hitch and I feel I am well on the way to reducing my dreaded electricity bills. Thanks Finn for recommending this company and thanks to QCS for delivering the goods. A win win situation.

Jimmy and the team arrived in the morning and the weather wasn't the best and they made me aware that job may not get completed on the day due to the weather which I completely understood.The boys got into the job and looks like they did a great job.System has been performing now for a month as I'd hoped it wouldI would suggest these guys for anyone looking for an install

My system is due to be installed on the 29th April. I found the Solar Quotes website so very informative as having no idea on solar it certainly helped me make an informed decision. I went with 21 x 315 watt mono Phono Panels, Fronius 5kw Primo Inverter including some tigo optimisers (due to shading)...looking forward to the installation and cheaper electricity bills :-)

The most difficult process was the research I did before engaging Solar Quotes, because there are just so many products around! When I contacted Solar Quotes, 3 sales reps gave me a quote and all were reasonable, but their systems were all slightly different. Therefore I decided to pretty much use the best that all 3 companies had to offer and came up with a tailor made system. I liked Mark's quote the best as I felt that he was very flexible on my ideas and he came back with a revised quote to accomodate the changes I made, while still giving me options. That was really great! Within 3 weeks Matt, Jimmy and Jack installed the system ( on a stinking hot day ) and had it all up and running by mid afternoon, what an effort. Jimmy explained what I needed to know to monitor the system and that was all done. Thanks to Mark, Matt, Jimmy and Jack for making this all happen, Very Happy.  ; ))
I highly recommend Queensland Commercial Group.Just fantastic in all aspects!My system not only looks great, but is functioning better then expected!A special thanks to all involved!

I need to go back and check your website, but it would be good to receive advice on how to get the best deal/return with tariff rates for feeding back into the grid. Eg, a list of which energy companies give the best deal.

Queensland Commercial Solar provided one of two quotes we requested through SolarQuotes.  They responded quickly, paid us a site visit within a couple of days, and provided a competitive quote.  We accepted their quote, and they were able to install the system within a fortnight.  Matt, Jimmy and Jack were quick and efficient, and although we haven't yet been able to get our meter changed to allow us to feed back into the grid, we're already generating power.  Our system was only installed six days ago, so we can't yet rate the system itself, but we're very happy with Queensland Commercial Solar's services to date and we'd be happy to recommend them to anyone.

Mark the sale rep was extremely helpful, didn't try to overdeliver and offered the best price. QCS didn't have many reviews so was a bit hesitant to go with them but as soon as Jimmy and the boys turned up they did a fantastic job. System is delivering amazing output. Highly recommend them.

Jimmy and Matt that did the installation were on time, professional, and worked under trying conditions between heavy rain falls.Explained exactly what they were doing, and gave a good run through of the system and how to make the most of it.Great service and extremely happy!????
i FOUND THE INFORMATION AND FEED BACK FROM YOU VERY HELPFULL TO WORK OUT WHAT I NEEDED TO KNOW.  ALSO WHAT TO ASK REGARDING QUOTES AND CHOOSING A INVERTER AND PANELS.MICHAEL QLD
All round a great company to deal with.
